::: {.project-facts}
**Role:** Co-applicant, responsible for the investigational medicinal product, N-of-1 methodology and the CYP2D6 and drug concentration analyses\
**Principal investigator:** Morten Lamberts, Herlev and Gentofte Hospital\
**Design:** Nationwide decentralised randomised trial, 520 participants, double-blind double-dummy N-of-1 crossover against standard care\
**Funding:** Independent Research Fund Denmark, 2027 to 2031
:::

Patients with persistent or permanent atrial fibrillation often report side effects on rate-control drugs, and the usual answer is to switch and hope. OPTIMUS-AF lets each patient compare metoprolol and verapamil blinded in their own crossover and uses CYP2D6 genotype and drug concentrations to explain who tolerates what.
